stories.title: Man sentenced to 29 years in jail for shooting and killing a man in northeast Spokane in 2024.
stories.summary: A Spokane judge sentenced Daniel Quinn, 40, to 29 years in prison for shooting and killing 36-year-old Thomas Reynolds at Thor St. and Cleveland Ave. two years ago.

stories.title: U.S. Marshals Service identifies the shooting suspect in Stevens County as 45-year-old Ronald Rutledge
stories.summary: Law enforcement is offering $3,500 for information leading to the arrest of 45-year-old Ronald Rutledge, the suspect in Stevens County shooting over the weekend.

stories.title: Spokane Colleges' campus food pantries get funding boost from MultiCare
stories.summary: MultiCare Health System’s Community Partnership Fund awarded $45,000 over the next three years to Spokane Colleges Foundation to support the food distribution.

stories.title: Washington bids to bring U.S. Space Academy to Federal Way
stories.summary: Washington proposes opening the academy at UW’s Seattle campus before moving to the former Weyerhaeuser headquarters site in Federal Way.

stories.title: 'Kids are getting hurt': Idaho lawmakers push for E-moto regulations
stories.summary: Idaho lawmakers are proposing new regulations for high-powered electric motorcycles, citing safety concerns and a growing number of injuries involving young kids.

stories.title: Police identify 'half-burned' body found during Seattle trail brush fire, death investigated as homicide
stories.summary: Firefighters discovered the body while responding to a brush fire near the Mountains to Sound Greenway Trail in August.

stories.title: Man dies in early morning house fire near Garland District
stories.summary: A man died in a house fire that was reported around 4:30 a.m. Monday. The cause of the fire is under investigation.

stories.title: Bird flu detected among cows at Grant County dairy farm
stories.summary: Grant County's Health District says it is the county's first detection of avian influenza in dairy cattle.

stories.title: You can help share the spirit of giving through the Tree of Sharing starting Friday, November 27
stories.summary: The organization, made up of a small but mighty group of volunteers, works each year to provide everyone with a special gift at Christmas.

stories.title: Spokane woman who hit boyfriend with car sentenced to 5 years in prison
stories.summary: A 41-year-old woman pleaded guilty to vehicular assault and hit-and-run charges after she pinned her boyfriend between her car and his motorhome and then fled.

stories.title: Coeur d'Alene Lighting Ceremony Parade returns Friday for its 34th year
stories.summary: This year's parade theme, Santa's Workshop, will transform Sherman Ave. into a festive celebration filled with twinkling lights, creative floats and holiday cheer.

stories.title: Nearly 1 million acres burned: Washington's DNR commissioner reviews state's worst wildfire season yet
stories.summary: Washington DNR Commissioner says the state just endured its most destructive wildfire season on record, urges lawmakers not to cut prevention funding.
